user_feedback: 现在的动画很不自然；用文件夹里现有结果优化动画的幅度、频率、自然性
inputs: R08 approved sources, masks, generated clean plates and eye rig unchanged (input-hashes.json verified)

changes.curves: Per-segment easing (saccade, ease-in contact, ease-out arrival, cubic in-out moves, small overshoot/settle, arcs) replaces one symmetric smoothstep for everything. Key times snapped to the 30 fps grid so repeated poses deduplicate.
changes.units: Timelines written in 192x208 display points (D=2/scale converts to source px); per-state GAINS removed.
changes.transform: Part transform gains a scale term about the pivot. respond/failed/verify move mostly by rigid wrist rotation + scale; translation reduced to cut the wrist stretch caused by the distance-weighted translation.

read_web.pointing-hand.reason: R05 pinned the fingertip; R06 pivots at the wrist/sleeve junction so the fingertip lifts and taps

changes.write_file: Rest pose is the approved contact drawing. Three irregular alternating bursts (TAP 5 frames, ENTER 7 frames), lift 3.4 deg left / 3.8 deg right, Enter 5.5 deg; eyes read the line after Enter.
changes.clean_plate: opaque_plate(): generated plates were 0-98% alpha inside the body; wherever the source is opaque the plate is made opaque, alpha<0.5 colour inpainted (Telea r=5). view_image: erase extended 3 px along the stylus shaft (x>440,y>700) to remove the residual outline line.

continuous_visual_review: not done by a human viewer; maker used stills and frame strips only
